items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Willie Ompford said, if you asked him now, Pete didn't lie all that.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, that was the way where they take the Excelsior, now the Excelsior brass band, they had some beautiful marches, and, well, Peter sometime would be playing a tune in or something. Well, Peter would get out the band, and coming back, second line, if you call him, coming on back from the graveyard, Peter would get out, because he knew he had to go play. Well, Charlie Love would take over. Well, Willie Ompford said, if you asked him now, Pete didn't lie all that. Yeah. See? And God dang it, they'd knock…
